title: Fivetran Platform Logs
descriptionMarkdown: Ingests Fivetran platform and connector logs into Microsoft Sentinel via the Azure Monitor Logs Ingestion API (DCR-based custom table). Fivetran PUSHES its own logs to a Data Collection Rule using an Entra ID app; this tile shows connection status and provides sample queries. It does not itself move data - ingestion is driven by Fivetran plus the DCR.

sampleQueries.query:
Fivetran_CL
| where Level in ("SEVERE", "WARNING")
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

sampleQueries.description: Event volume by level over time
sampleQueries.query:
Fivetran_CL
| summarize count() by Level, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)

dataTypes.name: Fivetran_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
Fivetran_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

value:
Fivetran_CL
| summarize LastLogReceived = max(TimeGenerated)
| project IsConnected = LastLogReceived > ago(30d)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: read and write permissions are required.

read permissions to shared keys for the workspace are required. [See the documentation to learn more about workspace keys](https://docs.microsoft.com/azure/azure-monitor/platform/agent-windows#obtain-workspace-id-and-key).

instructionSteps.title: 1. Register an Entra ID app for Fivetran
instructionSteps.description: In Microsoft Entra ID > App registrations, create an app and a client secret. Record the Application (Client) ID, Directory (Tenant) ID and secret value.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Create the custom table, DCE and DCR
instructionSteps.description: Deploy Fivetran_CL (columns TimeGenerated, Level, CreatedAt, Message) and a Data Collection Rule with stream Custom-Fivetran_CL and transform `source | extend TimeGenerated = CreatedAt`. See the michaelwoods-fivetran skill azure-setup.md.

instructionSteps.title: 3. Grant the app access to the DCR
instructionSteps.description: Assign the Entra app the Monitoring Metrics Publisher role on the DCR.

instructionSteps.title: 4. Configure Fivetran
instructionSteps.description: In Fivetran's external-log (Azure Monitor) setup form, choose the Logs Ingestion API mode and enter the Client ID, Tenant ID, Client secret, Logs Ingestion URI (or DCR logIngestion endpoint), DCR immutableId and stream name Custom-Fivetran_CL. Click Save & Test.
